whatsappMessage:

Maine aapke dental clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp consultation booking, services menu, aur patient testimonials integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/aditi

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Aditi Dental Clinic team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with a direct WhatsApp appointment booking feature and mobile-first design for your clinic in Mithapur. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?
